structure Order where
  customerName : String
  orderItems   : List String
  quantity     : Nat

structure Confirmation where
  customerName : String
  orderItems   : List String
  quantity     : Nat
  confirmation : Bool

def Spec : Contract Order Confirmation where
  pre o := true
  post o c := o.customerName = c.customerName ∧ o.orderItems = c.orderItems ∧ o.quantity = c.quantity ∧ c.confirmation

  let c := Confirmation.mk "John Doe" ["Item A", "Item B"] 5 true
  show Spec from
    by
      simp [Spec]
      exact true

structure ProductCode where
  code : String

structure Inventory where
  products : List (String × ProductCode)

structure Purchase where
  codes : List ProductCode

structure Owner where
  purchases : List Purchase

structure Contract (α : Type) where
  pre : α → Prop
  post : α → α → Prop

def Spec : Contract Owner Inventory where
  pre o := true
  post o o' := o.purchases = o'.purchases ∧ o'.products = o.products ++ (o.purchases.map (fun p => p.codes.map (fun c => c.code))).flatten

example : Spec (Owner.mk []) (Inventory.mk []) := by
  simp [Spec.post]

  purchaseHistory : List String
  confirmedOrders : List String

  viewPurchaseHistory : Option String

  account : Option Account

  purchaseHistory : Option String
  confirmedOrders : Option String

def Spec : Contract Input Output where
  pre input := do

    | some account => account.created

      output.account = none ∧
      output.contactInfo = none ∧
      output.purchaseHistory = none ∧
      output.confirmedOrders = none
